answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in bridge, expire in kernel, and dune lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 147 aliases as a result needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1551 identities would post 4362 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
